claim: tests/test_order_monitor_build_account_client.py is the ONLY test file for _build_account_client, and neither of its 2 tests asserts on cfg['mode'] at all, so the suite is structurally blind to CA-A04's monitor-dry-run-gate-reads-absent-attribute -- one of CLAUDE.md's own two declared execution gates (account-level mode: live|dry_run) can never fire for real, on any of 11 accounts, and no test would notice.
evidence: Read tests/test_order_monitor_build_account_client.py:1-56 in full: test_build_account_client_populates_market_type_for_linear_account (L8-31) uses `fake_acc = MagicMock()` (unconstrained) and asserts only cfg['market_type'], cfg['account_id'], client is not None. test_build_account_client_defaults_market_type_to_spot_when_attribute_missing (L34-56) uses `MagicMock(spec=["name", "exchange", "api_key_env"])` (mode excluded from spec, so `getattr(fake_acc, 'mode', 'live')` correctly raises+defaults, faithfully matching the real TradingAccount's missing-attribute shape) and asserts only cfg['market_type']=='spot'. `grep -n "cfg\['mode'\]\|cfg\[.mode.\]" tests/test_order_monitor_build_account_client.py` returns 0 hits. src/runtime/order_monitor.py:1722 `"mode": getattr(acc, "mode", "live") or "live"`; the dry_run gates consuming this cfg key are at order_monitor.py:1804, 1938, 1999, 2078.
